procedure_text: 步骤a:取1.1mol(134.2g)三氟乙醇钠,1.2mol(129.6g)碳酸钠,1.0mol(318g)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺基苯甲酸甲酯(化合物I),1000mL N,N-二甲基甲酰胺加入到反应器中,然后50℃保温2小时后,将反应液中的N,N-二甲基甲酰胺减压蒸除后,将残液加入300mL水中,用35％的盐酸调pH至弱酸性,冷却结晶,过滤,水洗,干燥得化合物II,称重得311.4g,收率90％。
procedure_summary: Sodium trifluoroethoxide, sodium carbonate and the bromomethyl methylsulfonyl benzoate ester are charged with N,N-dimethylformamide and held warm. The solvent is then distilled off under reduced pressure, the residue is taken into water and acidified to weakly acidic, and the solid is crystallised on cooling, filtered, washed with water and dried to give compound II.
notes: Document marker is the Chinese 步骤a, kept as step_label Step a; step count of two matches what A0 estimated. The step is one transformation, the trifluoroethoxide displacing the benzylic bromide, so is_one_pot is false: the acid adjustment, crystallisation, filtration, water wash and drying are all workup, not a second transformation. 50℃保温 2小时 is the only temperature printed and is recorded as the step temperature. 减压蒸除 of the N,N-dimethylformamide is a workup operation, so reaction pressure stays not_specified and the phrase sets concentration_method. The 35％ figure recorded in the concentration object belongs to the workup hydrochloric acid, not to the reaction medium; it is the only concentration the step prints. pH is given only as 弱酸性, weakly acidic, with no number, so ph_value stays null. Water is the crystallisation medium rather than a quench, so quenching_agent is null. 反应器 is written with no volume and no fittings, so reactor_type is the bare word reactor and stirring is left null: the text names no stirrer at all in this step. No 滴加 appears anywhere in this section; all charges go in together, so no dropwise profile is recorded. Arithmetic on the printed pairs: 1.1mol/134.2g implies 122.0, matching sodium trifluoroethoxide at 122.02, so that pair closes; 1.2mol/129.6g implies 108.0 against 105.99 for sodium carbonate, and 1.0mol/318g implies 318.0 against 341.60 for the named methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate, so both fail and molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. The numbers are recorded exactly as printed and nothing is corrected. The product mass and yield are self-consistent for an unknown product, 311.4g at 90％ from 1.0mol implying 346.0 g/mol, so no mass_balance_implausible is raised; the implied mass balance cannot be checked against a formula because 化合物II is a local label this section never defines and A1 left it unresolved, kept here verbatim. The printed Chinese writes the sulfonyl group as 甲磺基 without 酰 and A1 resolved it as printed. There is no IMAGE_EXTRACT span in these lines, so no drawing evidence and no drawing flag. Prior-section reaction registry was empty because the sections are being annotated in parallel, so cross-section linkage is null throughout; Examples 1 to 5 are alternative runs of one route rather than a sequence, so no cross-section precursor is expected.

procedure_text: 步骤b:取1mol上述反应所得的化合物II,溶解在1000mL的二氯乙烷中,然后在15-20℃温度条件下,半小时内加入含1.5mol(147g)1,3-环己二酮(化合物III)和3mol(405g)缩合剂HOBT及3mol(222g)氢氧化钙,再在15-20℃温度条件下搅拌反应8小时,然后水洗、减压浓缩加甲、醇打浆、过滤、干燥得到成品环磺酮(化合物IV)375.4g,纯度97.5％,收率87.5％。
procedure_summary: Compound II from the previous step is dissolved in dichloroethane, and the cyclohexanedione, the condensing agent HOBT and calcium hydroxide are added over a short period at the stated low temperature and stirred at that temperature. The mixture is then washed with water, concentrated under reduced pressure, slurried, filtered and dried to give the finished tembotrione.
notes: Document marker is the Chinese 步骤b, kept as step_label Step b. One transformation only, the HOBT mediated acylation of the 1,3-dione by the compound II acyl group to give tembotrione, so is_one_pot is false: the addition over half an hour and the following 8 hour stir are one reaction, and the water wash, concentration, slurry, filtration and drying are workup. 15-20℃ is printed twice, once for the addition and once for the stir, and both are the same range, so the range is the step temperature and the addition phrase is also carried in each added reagent's addition_profile. The half hour is an addition time, so it stays in addition_profile and time_h holds only the 8 hour reaction. No 滴加 appears in this section; the reagents are 加入 within half an hour, which is recorded as an addition profile without calling it dropwise. 减压浓缩 is workup and sets concentration_method, so reaction pressure stays not_specified. No stirrer type is named, only 搅拌反应, so stirring is left null. 二氯乙烷 is printed with no locant and 加甲、醇打浆 carries an enumeration comma inside the word, so both are kept exactly as A1 recorded them, unresolved; neither is read as whichever neighbouring compound looks likeliest. Linkage is confirmed by 上述反应所得的化合物II, an explicit reference back, and the identifier 化合物II is the product identifier of Step a. Arithmetic on the printed pairs: 1.5mol/147g implies 98.0 against 112.13 for 1,3-cyclohexanedione, which fails, so molar_mass_inconsistent is raised; 3mol/405g implies 135.0 against 135.13 for HOBT and 3mol/222g implies 74.0 against 74.09 for calcium hydroxide, so both of those close and neither is flagged. The product figures do not close against each other: tembotrione is 440.82, so 375.4g is 0.8516mol, that is 85.16％ of the 1mol charged, not the printed 87.5％, and 87.5％ of 1mol would be 385.72g; the printed mass and yield together imply 429.0 g/mol. The mass does not exceed the maximum the input moles allow, but the stated mass and stated yield disagree, so mass_balance_implausible is raised and every number is left exactly as printed. Purity 97.5％ is printed with no method, so purity_method is null and no analytics tag is emitted. There is no IMAGE_EXTRACT span in these lines, so no drawing evidence and no drawing flag. The prior-section reaction registry was empty because the sections are being annotated in parallel, so precursor_step points only within this section and cross-section linkage is null; Examples 1 to 5 are alternative runs of one route, not a sequence.
